ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:6 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity background. A large, contiguous high-intensity geometric blob is located on the superior-distal quadrant of the right lobe. Multiple small, high-contrast punctate white spots are distributed across both lobes, with higher density near the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate interior angle of 85 degrees and a bounding-box depth equivalent to roughly 15% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the entire trailing edge. Right lobe features significantly higher pixel-amplitude peaks (8-12 pixels) compared to the more uniform, lower-amplitude serrations on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave trajectory along the trailing edge from tips to notch; convex curvature on the lateral leading edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white pixel clusters (rosettes) are visible at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle-related scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (light gray on black) are visible on the medial surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular white scarring and apparent physical erosion at the distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, high-contrast circular low-intensity spot is positioned within the large high-intensity white region on the upper-right lobe.
